caseNameFull: Dothard, Director, Department of Public Safety of Alabama v. Rawlinson

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. M. D. Ala. [Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 976.] Motion of Walter S. Turner, Esquire, to permit G. Daniel Evans, Esquire, to argue pro hac vice on behalf of appellants granted. Motion of Morris Dees, Esquire, to permit Pamela S. Horowitz to argue pro hac vice on behalf of appellees granted.
